balls.text: Would it have been wide had he let it go? Chases the wide slower one - into the pitch - in the end, tries to carve it square, underedges it wide of the keeper. They scamper back for two. Partnership ends with 50 off 22
Full around fourth, driven through extra. Long-off cuts it off, there was a potential two but Stubbs settles for one
Slot and at the stumps, Axar takes a stride forward and clubs it through the line. Four down the ground
Bishnoi misses another toughie! Runs to the diagonal right from deep midwicket, got behind it but got no finger on it! Ball was in Axar's half and slugged it off the bottom of the bat

Bumper to Axar, who looks to ramp it real fine. It's just outside off and is not called a wide. Axar reviews. He was upright and sprung up as the ball neared. Third umpire says the leg is slightly bent and would've been around the helmet. Calls it a fair ball. I thought it was high enough for the decision to be overturned, but on we go

Skier, Bishnoi tracks back from cover... and drops it! He couldn't go back at pace, rotated to the left and tried to take it around his chest. But the ball popped out and travelled a few metres further. Was a full ball that he tried to whack across the line. They scamper back for... three?! Worth taking the chance?
Yorker outside off, square driven to deep point, and more importantly, retain strike
Tremendous inside-out drive over extra to bring up fifty! Stubbs smiles, so does the dugout and the fans. He got a slot ball that he could step-hit. Lovely launch
Stoinis saves two, running to the right and diving at deep point. Was a length ball outside off that square-driven with power

This is more like it, Stubbs hits the advertising high on the pavillion! Slower one into the pitch, spun back in but that just brought it closer to Stubbs, he didn't hold anything back on that flat-batted pull. Almost a second-decker, bounced back off the walls too
This time it's absolutely muscled. Slower bouncer is around chest-height and Stubbs makes room, lifts the back leg as he monsters the pull wide of long-on
Steals two to long-on but why dink length balls now? It's at the body and he tapped it defensively rather than mow it across.
Makes room and carves it in the gap to the left of deep point. Axar was well outside leg and the line of the ball was around fifth, he had to lean across with his torso and with hands too
On-point yorker! Pure pace too. Axar was literally kept on his toes and all he could do was jam it in front
Pulls the shortish back of lengther to deep square leg

Slot ball is wide, Stubbs standing diagonally (with back foot outside off and deep in the crease) means that he is close enough to the line. Tries to power it through the line, not middled but enough to clear the long-off fence
Tries to pull and gets beaten, ball deflects off the body through the side of the pitch
Almost trickles back onto the stumps, Axar gets his bat in one bat and jams the ball back hockey-style. Was slowish and at the body, Axar swivelled for the pull and got it off the back of the bat
Dinked between deep midwicket and long-on, they scamper back for two. Was a shortish ball at the body that was flicked gently
Shortish outside off, tries cutting it, gets it off the bottom-half of the bat to deep thied
Pulls the short slower one to deep midwicket
Shortish outside off, caressed off the back foot to deep point

Wide line, slow pace works for Naveen against Pant. One-handed again but 110ks meant Pant had to nail that to clear long-on. His reach wasn't good enough to drag it from just inside the tramline. Ball had a lot of air time Hooda was right under it for a dolly. He was close to the cushion but took it in front of the chest even as his back leg lunged behind. Smart stuff from Naveen
Pant's doing freaky stuff,  loses the new bat that he got and guided the wide, full ball for a four through third. Used his bat like a conveyor belt almost

Reverse ramp between keeper and slip! Pre-meditated - front foot went a little outside leg peg first, the back leg reached out farther for him to lunge low and pick it up gracefully. The fact that it was full and angling away helped him.
But it doesn't matter as Stubbs gets it straight of long-off. DC's 150 is up. He was deep in the crease, went across and belted it off a fullish length almost
Keeps it out of the arc again, this time it's full and just inside the tramline. Stubbs got on one knee and tried bashing it over cover
Wide on a fullish length. But Arshad too wide trying to keep it away from the arc, let go
And Stubbs promptly goes over long-on. Length ball was pretty much in the slot given the field, not that wide too, so it was in his reach for a heave
Great one-handed hook, but deep fine leg - Mohsin - is almost a long stop. Ball rises on the bounce and pushes him on one knee but he manages to hold onto the ball with both hands
Pant finishes with feet spread apart but after completing the pull. Was a hard-length ball angling in at the body that cramped him for room
Stubbs makes room, gets well outside leg, and Mohsin outsmarts him. Goes yorker-ish at sixth. Stubbs feels it's too far to even reach out with the bat. It's well inside the guidelines

Ball's at deep third, bat's at square leg! Pant wanted to slog sweep this slot ball but from well outside off, went too hard and the bat flew off the hands. He didn't move across the crease or lean much. Guess he might err on the side of balance after getting funky and missing out on a few balls earlier
Slow on a length at fifth, back-foot square drive is mistimed. Goes to cover

Backs away early and gets followed by a hard-length ball. Pulled to deep midwicket. Throw's good but it bounces waywardly. High even for Rahul at cover but he leaps up and just about manages to mitt it in
Wide on a length, 129ks, looked like he ran the fingers over it. Cut to deep point
Length outside off, cut to deep point

5head from Krunal, tosses it up generously to beat the cut. That ball was an oasis in the desert of darts that's made up most of the pitch map so far. On a length, angling away through sixth, Pant went hard with another back-foot cut. Got beat by lack of pace and extra bounce. Timeout
Length around off, punched to long-off
Full and flat on off, drilled to long-on. 109ks. Risky line but not giving Pant much time
Krunal changes the line but Pant's onto him. Goes back in the crease and chops the wide length ball through the gap behind backward point. Seemed slow even though it was 96ks.

Amazing leap to the left from Pooran, running from deep midwicket, but Pant had powered the pull so well, he couldn't lay finger on it. Was a length dart at the body that Pant, coil-pulled with a stable torso.
Fullish length ball on the pads, 97ks, clipped to midwicket
Beaten on the cut and Pant yells in frustration. Length on fifth, 104ks, he tried to leather it square. Right shot but Bishnoi beats him with pace. Ends an awesome spell
Pant is smarter this time, holds onto a stable base, and powers the cut with his core. It races to the right of long-off, fielder hared but ball won the race
Darted on a length, fifth-stump line, Pant whisks a cut to point. He was falling over a bit too. Trying to make room against Bishnoi is a bit too tough
Defensive punch is firm and goes past Bishnoi, as he dives to the left, to long-off. Length ball around off it was
Full and wide, driven to deep cover
Length around off, defended in front
Slow on a length, defended towards cover

Pants falls over while pulling and does well to not tread back onto the stumps. His feet were scissoring as he tried sliding across to meet the shortish ball just outside off, but he tripped and was on the turn. Stopped midway as the ball went to fine leg
Slower bumper is just outside off, bunt-pulled to deep midwicket
Shortish at the body, pace-on again, pulled to deep-backward square leg
Pace-on, very full around fourth, punched to long-off

Naveen reaps the benefits of the pressure built by the spinners. He went slow on a length, first ball into his return spell, line was at the legs. Porel went as hard as he'd done regularly tonight with the pull. It was off the front foot and hit it off the area just under the sticker. Ball went flat towards deep midwicket. Pooran came in, judged it well to go back and take just inside the rope. He tossed the ball in front, but the balance was good enough, for him to take it with ease on the second attempt
Full around off, whipped to long-on. Excellent defensive bowling from Bishnoi
A stump or two straighter and Porel's beaten on the cut again. He fell over this time. The front foot outside leg didn't help gain access.
Very wide on a fullish length, 103ks. Just near the tramline. Porel went hard with the cut, couldn't reach
Wide on a length, cut through backward point. Fielder runs to the right to stop it
Goes back and works it off the back foot to deep square leg. Bishnoi is on his haunches, feeling that was close to beating bat
Length around off, darted like almost always, Porel's front foot is out the way as he bunts it with an open face towards backward point
Darted on middle, the length ball has been punched to deep cover
Length just outside off, sat up for the cut, beaten. Just 91ks, extra bounce did him. The pace was there for the shot
Flatter on off, driven to deep cover
A bit short and Pant crouches. In fact, it's just the feet lunging, upper body's straight as he nails the pull square of the wicket
Just a bit down leg but it's going with the angle, beats the pull
Worked to long-on
Pant dances down, Hooda follows him with a fullish dart, clipped through midwicket
Fullish dart lands well outside off and angles away further. Skidding too much for Porel to connect with the attempted dab to third
Short and wide, cut square for a couple
Pitched right up, Pant not looking to tonk that. He's into the straight-bat punch and manages to get it to long-off

Rahul takes it on the second attempt, really tough too as the ball popped a few feet to his right, but his initial clasp had taken the pace off it, allowing him to dive low and hold on low. Was a full wide ball at 92ks that Hope tried thrashing off the front foot. The owner's pleased
Tries to pull the cover off of it, misses and gets hit on the belly
DC not allowing bowlers to set the rhythm first ball. This time Hope effectively slog-swept a full ball outside off, over long-on

Krunal's recovered superbly after the first ball. He finishes on a hard length just outside off, giving no time to adjust. Porel was in the crease and square-on but could only plink the cut back to th bowler
Flat on a length. Bail trimmer at 94ks, Hope tries to punch it straight, inside edges it towards midwicket
Length on leg, helped fine off the back foot
Length on the pads, clipped to the leg side
Length down leg, Hope slides leg side and looks to flick it. Ball goes past him, QDK whips off the bails again. Referral made by the ump. Hope tip-toed and managed to keep the back leg in the crease
Looks to flick the length ball, inside edges it towards square leg. Porel brings up fifty in just 21 balls. There's a salute too. Lot of applause and appreciation from the fans his team-mates
Porel's not gonna make that easy. He went for the late cut, which was a challenge as Krunal came from around the wicket, but there was pace and he used it to run it straight of short third
Darted on a length, punched from middle stump to long-on. Mostly (and understandably) defensive bowling from Bishnoi. He didn't get much turn but was effective
Full and angling away, Porel misses the flashing cover drive off the front foot. Bails are off, stumping referral made. The back foot was out of the crease but Porel managed to slide it back in time.
Wide and full, 100ks, Hope reaches out and has a splash. Calls of catch it but it lands safely and rolls to long-off
Stays back in the crease and uses the width, cuts it off a length to deep point

Googly finds the edge, rolls to backward point's right and Pooran misfields. He charged and the ball spun to the right, so he overran and the ball went back. Was a quick length ball around off, Porel was squared-up on the back foot. Tried to defend it straight
Very full, a bit wide. Not sure if it pitched, but Hope reached out and drove it to the off-side sweeper
Yorker missed, it's a pacy full toss on top of the pads. Porel hurried a bit but manages to glance it fine. The 73-run powerplay has led LSG to opt for an early timeout
Length at the stumps, defended in front
Pace-on bouncer and it's hooked fine. Almost a 360-degree swivel from Porel, twirls all over the place and the ball goes fine for an 85-metre six
Another pull beaten by a slower bouncer, this hits the forearm of his back hand. That's how slow it was. Porel will be checked again
Pace-off bumper is around the lid, angling away just outside off. Porel swivels and tries to pull it, gets beaten
Slow on a length, just down leg again. The attempted glance was gentle and the ball went past him
Loosener down leg, real wide and Porel's bottom hand came off as he tried pulling it fine. Managed to pick up the slower ball and got a 64-metre six. Shorter boundary there
Slow, into the pitch, is working much better for LSG. This is angling away just outside off and beats Hope's pull

Appeal for caught behind. Aawaz aaya, Mohsin says. But that hit the helmet, so it's hard to tell. Long chat but no review. Was the slower bumper again, Hope was early into the pull and swivelling as the ball grazed the helmet. The physio will check him
Hope makes room to open up the off side but Mohsin manages to follow him far enough to allow no room. Swings hard but the elbows crank down and he grunts while getting beaten
Slow again, think LSG have worked out that's the way to go. Real short, Hope has a heave and misses
Hope slashes for the hills, edges the slower ball that's full and wide, and gets it over short third. Everything working against LSG
Tries to punch the fullish slower one through cover, mistimes it to mid-off.
Goes slower this time. Length around off, Hope collapses while pulling, plinks it to deep square leg. Fifty up at the end of the fourth!
No good length ball is going unpunished. Hope stands tall again and heaves it wide of and over long-on. Seven boundaries in the last two overs
More flat-bat pancaking. Hope's standing tall and forcing hard-length balls like it's child's play. Ball was just below waist-height and Hope had to spring up, got it off the middle though
Not a bad ball, not too dissimilar from the last ball, but it's belted wide of mid-off. The line was around fifth, that might have been the only issue but still, that's dismissive hitting
Back of length just outside off, punched off the top of the bounce to point
Short and wide, Hope goes hard at it. Maybe too hard, gets beaten. Line was close to the tramline and it looked to have bounced more than the batter expected
Spanked through extra cover. Porel's batting like a dream. This was a half-volley outside off, swing or not he was drumming that on one knee. Nobody moved
Fullish on middle and off, 141ks, good speed off the pitch too. Hope is compact, on the back foot. Punches it gently towards mid-off
Goes for the yorker, gets close. The 141ks ball lands just outside the crease. There's a bit of swing away, punched off the front foot to mid-off
Sharp bouncer, at the body. Ducked under. Uh oh, wide called. Marginal call
Porel's reading Arshad easily, he set up for the shortish ball which and got it at the body. Stood tall before pulling it, swivelled on one knee and watched it sail over midwicket
Shades of Ganguly as Pore dances down while making room and slaps it through cover. Picked it up off a length and smeared it with the full flow
Whipped on the up, it's not middled and goes high but has enough to land deep in the outfield and beat the chasing midwicket fielder
Fullish on middle, worked back to the bowler
Length just outside off, a bit of extra bounce but Porel rides it well while running it to deep third
Shortish and wide, Porel's backlift goes long, the wait is just enough to middle the upper-cut over deep third
Full and wide, giving it space to swing but it's not there. The angle is good enough to create the edge as Hope slashed, aiming towards cover. Went safely to deep third
Fullish on leg, 141ks, ball beats the flick and goes off the deflection towards midwicket
Length at the stumps, blocked in front
Away swing beats the cover drive. Pitched right up, there was width and Porel's front foot stepped across. There was a flurry too, leading to some oohs and aahs
Back of length outside off, steered off the back foot to point
Pitched up on off, Hope shows the full face on the drive to send it downtown. Arshad half-stops it by stretching out with his left hand, deflects it to mid-off's left

Down leg again. 139ks, Arshad's bowling good gas. It's full, lands outside leg and swings in further. Hope shaped for the glance, there's a sound and it's not given wide. Capitals review. There's no contact detected by Ultra-Edge so the decision changes
Clips the length ball on the hips through backward square leg

Arshad has FMcG fall into the trap he'd set at long-on! He went length at the stumps, it swung in a bit and the batter cleared the front stool again and tried to smash it with a semi flat-bat. Ball hit the sticker thanks to the bounce, went right up. Rahul knew Naveen was in contention. All he had to do is move left and take a dolly. LSG's move to start with Arshad pays off.
Almost trims the top of the stumps! Inswinger on the heart of a length, swings in after landing around off and FMcG cleared his feet and tried heaving over the leg side. Beaten
FMcG misses out again. This was length but closer to slot for the help-away flick but the swing took the ball too far
There's swing and good carry but it meant the ball landed just outside leg and went past the flick
another yorker swinging into off, and jammed back to the bowler's left. DC win by 19 runs, and manage to stay alive in the tournament
ahh, another slower ball, and fullish length just outside off. Naveen looks to swipe, but is beaten
goes for the reverse scoop, but it is a slower ball at 106kph on a fullish length just outside off, and so Naveen is beaten
ohh, excellent execution, as he nails a yorker on middle and off. Squeezed to long-off
full and just outside off. He hoicks wide of long-on from the inside half of the bat, and they can get only two
low full toss angling into off, and chipped towards long-off. They don't run

yorker angling into off, and he flat-bats to deep third. LSG opt to risk the second, even as Pant whips the bails off and looks confident for a potential run-out. But no, replays show Naveen has managed to drag his bat back as he was diving. So Arshad retains strike
very full on middle and leg, and whipped to deep midwicket

Mukesh is animated in his appeal for lbw, but it is turned down. He convinces Pant to review. On a full length on leg... but replays actually show it pitched outside leg, as Arshad looked to clip but was hit on his front pad

full toss on his knee on the stumps, and clipped to deep midwicket. And, and... there is a direct hit at the non-striker's end! The umpire refers it upstairs, even as Bishnoi starts walking back. And the replay confirms that Bishnoi was well short, although he did decide to dive, but it was too late by then. Superb work by Fraser-McGurk in the deep, having dropped a simple catch earlier in the day
on the bounce to deep square leg running forward! Mukesh bowled short and outside off, as Bishnoi went pulling, but thankfully for LSG, mistimed it perfectly
good work by Axar. He was at long-on, and moved to his right to take it on the bounce, as Arshad swung at this shortish ball down the ground
swat-swings this length ball down the pitch to keep the strike
fifty off 25 balls! Jams it down the ground off a full length, as long-off cuts it off his left
ohh, this is a yorker around off, which Arshad jams with a flat bat towards long-off. They pinch two to leave Pant unhappy

sliced into the sightscreen! Wow, he just opened the face of the bat at this low full toss, which was angling across to finish around sixth stump. His front leg was out of the way, and bang went the ball!
a dipping yorker just outside off, and pushed to mid-off for a hurried single
angles this across, and bowls a low full toss outside off. Drilled to long-off

finds long-off! Yudhvir's cameo ends, as DC keep striking to push LSG back. Hope on the boundary took a few steps to his right while keeping his eyes on the ball along. Khaleel banged it on a short of a length, and got it to angle away to end outside off. Yudhvir went swatting, but couldn't clear the boundary
looks to whip this length ball but gets it off his pad, with the ball trickling towards point
uff, this is clever from Arshad! He reads the slower ball, which is short outside off. But it angles in towards off, and Arshad bisects short third and point in managing to chip it late
clubbed over the bowler's head! Length ball from Khaleel, who bowls on the stumps. But Arshad is deep in the crease, and hammers it back for six more
much fuller, but outside leg, as Arshad looked to flick but missed. And DC review the wide call. The third umpire confirms that there is no bottom edge involved, and it remains wide
slower ball at 116kph, and on a short of a length around off, even as he went from back of the hand. Hooked over square leg for six!
ohh, fires in an inswinging yorker on middle at 137kph, leaving Arshad floored, as he almost falls on his stomach
full toss angling across and finishing low and wide-ish of off. Lofted on the bounce to long-off
angles this across, and bowls a yorker outside off. He looks to jam his bat down, but is beaten
dropped by Fraser-McGurk at deep square leg! Salam bowled a slower ball on a length on middle - he went from the back of the hand - as Yudhvir pulled, but Fraser-McGurk put down a sitter
change of pace, and on a length on middle. Clipped aerially towards fine leg for two more
hooked over fine leg! Salam banged this in short on middle, and the ball ended towards leg, with Yudhvir hooking stylishly behind square
swiped to deep midwicket! On a length just outside off, and Yudhvir waits before heaving across the line to find the gap
chips this off the inside half of the bat, and the ball lands wide of long-on
ahh, this hints to turn away off a length on middle and off, and goes over the stumps, with Yudhvir half-pushing at it

Krunal runs out of patience! He skips down the pitch early, and Kuldeep fires one fullish and around sixth stump. The ball turns away to end further wide outside off, leaving Pandya completely beaten by the line and then the turn. Pant had a lot of time to whip the bails off, sending Pandya back, with the latter not finding any momentum
full length on middle and leg, and slower. Nudged towards square leg
angles this in, and bowls full on his pads. Arshad sweeps off the bottom of the bat, and the ball rolls away behind the pitch to frustrate Kuldeep
a low, dipping full toss on leg, and swept to deep midwicket
six over long-on. Bam! Arshad sees a length delivery angling across and ending just outside off, and swings at it to hit a big six
another short ball, and this is just outside off. It is called second bouncer, even as Arshad attempted to hook but missed
a yorker angling across, and landing wide of off at 136kph. He looks to slice, but is beaten
now Ishant bowls a bouncer outside off, which Arshad looks to pull but misses
clubbed down the ground! This hardly seemed to be four when hit, though. Length ball, which is wide of off, as Arshad swats it back to beat long-off to his left
shorter side of a length, and angling away to finish around sixth stump. Slapped to deep point
pushes this to cover
slower, and full outside off. He went slogging, but missed
bashed down the pitch! The length seemed too full for that shot, though, as Arshad lofted it from off stump, and dumped the ball beyond the sightscreen
fullish length on off and turning away. Whipped to long-on
yorker length, and on the stumps. Pandya rams it back, and long-on moving to his right misfields to let the ball go. Would have been at most two runs there
full ball dipping just outside off, and hinting to turn in. Slashed to deep point
much fuller length around off, and driven to cover

ahh, Naib at deep midwicket runs and slides to his right. He manages to drag the ball towards long-on running to his left, and they keep it to two. Short of a length just outside off, and pulled by Pandya
good bounce off a length from wide of off, and Pandya lets it go. Wide called
slower ball, and on a length on ff. It shapes away, and is pushed towards mid-off for a rapid run
short of a length, and rising over off. Left alone
uff, sharp movement there! On a short of a length on middle, and the ball zips through over the stumps, and in the gap between pad and bat, as Arshad looked to push forward

taken at extra cover! Pooran, who thinks the catch might not have been clean, has a word with Pandya, with the latter suggesting his partner walk back. The verdict is given by the third umpire, who confirms that Axar took it well even as he was diving across to his right. Mukesh, bowling from over the wicket, banged it in short. The ball angled away as it was also a slower ball, with Pooran swatting it from outside off and finding Axar
full and flatter on off. Poked to point, as Kuldeep gives away just four
full ball dipping just outside off. Swept towards deep midwicket
full and on the stumps, as Kuldeep slows it down to 80kph. Nudged towards deep midwicket, and they pinch two
full and tossed up just outside off. Lofted on a few bounces to long-off
short of a length, and wide of off. Pandya skips down, and uses his pad to defend
full and slow on off, and tucked back towards the bowler

misfield by Axar at extra cover, and that is four! He seemed to moving to his left when the ball went there, but it slipped below his hands. Length ball from Mukesh, and angling across to finish outside off, as Pooran hacked at it to eventually find the gap between long-off and deep point
whips this to long-on to keep ticking
drilled down the ground! Driven between the stumps and the non-striker. A full toss at a comfortable height, and just pushed forward
wide called, as Mukesh bowls a pretty short and wide of off. The ball takes off, and Pandya looks to ramp but misses
on a length at only 118kph, and angling away to outside off. Pooran adjusts for the lack of pace before pushing to deep point
short of a length just outside off, and a slower one. Swatted to deep point after making room
starts with a yorker on off, which Pandya jams back to the bowler
ahh, this was a wayward wide had he let it go. Pooran made room early, and Naib bowled short and wide of off. Pooran still went slashing, and got a bottom edge towards Pant
very full, and angled into the stumps. Clipped to fine leg
pulls his length back to go shorter, and Pooran trashes it to long-on
ahh, timed brilliantly off his pads! Pooran also raises his fifty. On a length on leg, and a late tickle to beat short fine to his right
short of a length just outside off, and swat-pulled wide of long-on! Pooran plants his front foot forward before shifting his weight back to hammer that in the gap
ohh, bowls at just 98kph to go full on his pads. Pooran whips it towards deep square from deep in the crease, and they run two
ahh, slower from Stubbs, and full outside off. Pooran went driving, but got the inside half of the bat, with the ball rolling to long-on
full again, but on the stumps. Driven down to long-on
tosses it up, and bowls full on leg. Pandya looked to flick, but was hit on his pad

finds long-off! Stubbs angles this across the right-hander, given he was bowling from around the stumps. There were a lot of revs on the ball, which was dipping on a full length towards fifth stump. Badoni presented the full face of the bat to chip that down the ground, but couldn't clear even the shorter side, with Naib posted right on the edge of the boundary
fuller and flatter on off, and Badoni gets the toe end of the bat as he looks to have a swing
on a length on middle and leg, and clipped towards deep square leg. Stubbs himself gives the chase, even as the batters nab two
slower, and on a fullish length on middle and off. He goes back in the crease and blocks it down
tucks this towards deep square, and they pinch two
reverse sweep over extra cover, of all regions! He switches over early, and Kuldeep bowls on a length down the leg side. Pooran clatters the ball to the other side of the ground for a big six
slows it down, and bowls full on off. Swept to short fine leg, as Pooran sends Badoni back
on a fullish length, and hinting to turn away towards off. Nudged towards square leg
full ball dipping on off, and swept fine leg while almost falling over
short delivery at 135kph just outside off, and Badoni dabs it to square leg

gets a leading edge dribbling to short third, as Badoni is squared up by this length ball which is angled in but straightens to finish around fifth stump, with Badoni also a bit across the stumps while looking to clip
slower ball, and it is almost a yorker-length delivery on middle and off. Flicked to deep midwicket

flung away to fine leg! Mukesh angles this into the left-hander, but ends up bowling on a length on off. Pooran swipes across the line, and the ball flies off the inside half of the bat to go over short fine leg
shorter side of a length, and a bit wide of off. Slashed behind point

this goes miles up... and just lands for six! Mukesh bowled on a length on middle, and the ball seemed to just about shape back in, as Pooran hoicked it over midwicket. The ball landed just beyond the boundary
another one at a change of pace. This is full and just outside off, and blocked towards cover
slower ball again. This is angled in, and bowled on a length on off. It straightens away, and Badoni pokes it towards point, where a fumble allows a second
on the slightly shorter side of a length on off, and tapped towards point for a single
short delivery at a change of pace - just 112kph - on middle and off, as Pooran went to hook but missed. There was good bounce and carry there for Ishant
full length just outside off, and pushed to mid-on for a quick single

confident appeal for lbw, and given! Hooda begins walking back, before Pooran nudges him to review. There is no inside edge there, as confirmed by UltraEdge. Ishant bowled on the shorter side of a length just outside off, as the ball was angled in. It pitched and moved in towards leg, as Hooda looked to clip but missed. Replays show the ball would have hit the top of leg, so Hooda has to return eventually, with LSG losing a review

another slower ball from Axar, but this is six! That is 20 off the over! Full delivery angled across towards off, and Pooran waits before clobbering it over deep midwicket to spoil Axar's over further
full and flat just outside off. Pooran again has a hoick, and the ball drags away off the inside half of the bat to beat square leg to his right
Axar slows it down nicely, and goes on a length just outside off. There is no turn, even as Pooran looks to sweep again but is beaten
massive six over deep square leg! Pooran utilising his match-up against Axar, who bowls on a length, and on the stumps. But Pooran is deep in crease, and slog sweeps it far away
swung away to deep midwicket! On a length around off, and he goes across the line to smack the it first ball

stumped first ball! Stoinis decided to attack Axar right away by skipping down the pitch, but was beaten. Pant whipped the bails off with Stoinis way down the pitch, but the third umpire just wanted to confirm if Pant had collected the ball behind the stumps. Axar angled this ball in, and bowled full around sixth stump. Stoinis was skipping down the pitch already, though, and was beaten by the turn away from him
short of a length, and wide of off. Hooda goes slashing away from his body, but is beaten by the away movement and the bounce

nabbed at mid-on! Mukesh is in the action again, and this time he times his jump perfectly. He had to leap with his hands above his head, and managed to grab that ball with a reverse cup. Ishant bowled a slower ball to de Kock, and went on a full length on a stump-to-stump line. The length seemed a bit too full to facilitate de Kock's attempted heave, and de Kock could hit it only as far as mid-on
fuller side of a length on middle and off, and nudged to deep square leg
fuller length, and around middle and leg. Driven to mid-on

dropped by Khaleel! But the first impression was that the ball raced on towards him, as de Kock clipped this fullish ball angling into his pads by playing aerially. The ball went to Khaleel's left at short fine leg. He got his left hand out, but the ball brushed it and went for four
backs away, and swipes over midwicket! De Kock made some room early, as Ishant angled this to bowl on a length. The ball finished around leg stump, as de Kock got the line he wanted to attack
another wide. This time the length is much fuller than the previous ball, but the line is again outside leg. De Kock looked to swing his bat but missed, and the ball is given wide
wide outside leg. Angles this in, and lands this on the shorter side of a length on leg. The ball keeps sliding down, as de Kock lets it go
short of a length, and angling away towards off. Punched to cover
swatted over mid-off! Short of a length from Khaleel, and pitching on middle and off. It seemed like an offcutter too, but Stoinis waited before slamming it away without any foot movement
ahh, a tight line there! Bowls on a length around middle and off while angling it across, and Stoinis lets it go, even as there is some extra bounce off the pitch
angles this across the right-hander, and bowls full and a bit wide of off. Dragged to mid-off with a flat bat
on a length on fifth stump, and dabbed behind towards square leg for a hurried single
angles this in, and bowls full and wide of off. De Kock went driving, but found mid-on
more movement for Ishant into the right-hander, as this one swings in to land on a full length around sixth stump. Stoinis went pushing, but got it off the inside half of the bat to square leg

taken by Mukesh after two attempts! He almost avoided a collision with the deep-third fielder running in too. Mukesh, placed at cover-point, turned around and ran forward, with the ball dropping over his head. He had to go low and grab it with both hands, with the deep-third fielder running forward and coming in his eyeline. All this happened after Rahul went lofting at this length ball angled into off, but moving away after pitching to finish outside off. Rahul lost his bottom hand there, with the ball sticking in the surface
full length, and angled into off stump. Dabbed down towards point after opening his stance up

ahh, some nice inswing for Ishant! The ball was angled in, and bowled on a fullish length in the channel outside off. Rahul went to loft, but the excessive swing meant the ball took the inside half of the bat, and went towards mid-on
clipped for four! Ishant angles this into the right-hander, and bowls on a length on his pads. Rahul waits for it to come, before flicking his bat late to beat Pant to his left
fuller side of a length just outside off. Tapped to cover for a quick single
